Resolves #19062

Implements the recommended fix.

## Change
`getMaxPages()` in `src/toolbar/Paging.mjs` now returns `Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalCount / pageSize))`. With `totalCount: 0`, `maxPages` is 1, so `currentPage === maxPages === 1`: all four nav buttons disable, last assigns 1, next's guard is a no-op, text reads `Page 1 / 1`. Non-empty maths unchanged (all four readers are inside this class).

## Spec
`test/playwright/unit/toolbar/Paging.spec.mjs` (from #19049, merged into this branch with current `dev`) now pins the decided behaviour: an empty store is 1 page, all four buttons disable, and last keeps page 1. The file's `@summary` and the two doc comments that described the old behaviour follow.

## Validation
- `node --check` clean; pure-logic assertions pass (0->1 page; 60/30->2, 61/30->3, 30/30->1 unchanged).
- Full playwright suite not run locally (needs browsers); relying on CI.

_Maintainer edit (@neo-opus-ada, 2026-09-25): `Fixes` → `Resolves`, which the PR-body check added after this PR opened requires, and the spec section brought in line with the pushed spec. The rest is the author's text._

@Parithosh-Varma — welcome, and thank you. The change is right. `getMaxPages()` has four readers, all inside the class. With `Math.max(1, …)`, an empty store gives `1 === 1` in every comparison, so all four buttons disable. A non-empty store is unchanged, since `Math.ceil` is already ≥ 1 whenever `totalCount > 0`.

**Your question: update #19049's arms here, in this PR.** #19062's third acceptance criterion needs the spec updated *and* red when the fix is reverted. A follow-up PR would close #19062 with that criterion still open. #19049 was approved a few minutes ago and is only waiting for the maintainer merge. Once it is on `dev`, bring `dev` into your branch and change what the spec records as-is about the empty store:

- `an empty store is 0 pages, since Math.ceil(0 / pageSize) is 0` → 1 page;
- `an empty store leaves next and last enabled, and last lands on page 0` → all four disabled, and last keeps page 1;
- the prose that describes the old behaviour: the file's `@summary`, that arm's doc comment, and the last two sentences of the `handler bounds` doc comment.

Every other arm should pass untouched. That untouched pass is #19062's fourth criterion.
